description: FAIRiCUBE deposits a 2021 land-cover raster for Luxembourg City as one public 10-metre GeoTIFF under CC BY 4.0. The provider defines land cover as the observed physical or biological material on the ground. A modeller could use its surface classes to place rough runoff or urban-heat parameters around drainage assets and public space. The page does not publish a legend, class codes, mapping method, validation or a source imagery date beyond the filename, so a parameter mapping would require further documentation. The map is not a drainage-network or land-use-zoning dataset. Round one rejected it after screening for energy infrastructure, but the broader current catalogue includes cross-cutting land layers for stormwater and urban climate simulation. That makes the rejection too narrow under the present reuse rule. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this city release. The raster was not downloaded and its classes were not inspected.
name: Land Cover City of Luxembourg
notes: G6 item G6-2212. Metadata-only draft. Simulation-use and type tags are reviewer classifications. File contents and software execution were not checked. Unknown maturity does not assert active maintenance.
